title: Modern Data Protection Checklist for Cloud-First Enterprises | Commvault
summary: Strengthen cloud data protection with a modern checklist for cyber resilience, clean recovery, and continuous business.
body_markdown:
What is modern data protection?


Modern data protection helps unify cloud data protection, threat detection, immutable backups, and secure data recovery so businesses can keep data available, trusted, and recoverable across cloud-first environments.


How can I choose the right data protection solution for regulatory compliance and ransomware resilience?


Look for a platform that combines backup and recovery, immutable storage, threat detection, governance, compliance reporting, and rapid recovery capabilities. The right solution should protect data across multi-cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments while helping align with frameworks such as NIST and support cyber resilience before, during, and after an attack.
